messages:
emmie_partnerships: Heads-up: Novus wants to publish a "Novus Appliance" bundle in the cloud marketplace — includes quantized weights + hardware image. Need a clear onboarding checklist for redistribution + hosting options.
novus_partner: hey! we can provide quantized weights, a short provenance manifest, and either PGP signed statement or notarized attestation. aiming for a soft launch in 6 weeks.
omar_legal: Quick summary: we require a redistribution addendum (one-paragraph grant + contact), a copy of the upstream model license, and dataset provenance. Also add export-control checkbox and takedown procedure.
tanvi_marketplace: Marketplace rules: for hosted SKUs we need license.txt, checksum file, contact email, and explicit "hosting_preference": ["hosted","download-only"]. Hosted SKUs must provide cryptographic proof for artifacts.
leo_engineering: Minimal engineering manifest we'll ask for: model_card.json (arch, params, quantization), tokenizer files, weights SHA256, and a provenance_statement.txt (signed). We'll run a quick sandbox deploy on staging that verifies resource profile.
novus_partner: can you share an example model_card.json?
leo_engineering: sample snippet:
`{ "model_name": "novus-8b-q4", "params": "8B", "quantization": "int4-ptq", "weights_sha256": "<sha256>", "tokenizer": "sentencepiece", "approx_vram_mb": "8000" }`
artifact-scan-bot: scan id 7782: preview upload missing license.txt and provenance_statement.txt — failing checks. logs: https://ci.internal/artifacts/7782
omar_legal: If upstream license is permissive (Apache/MIT/CC-BY) redistribution generally allowed with attribution. If copyleft, addendum must include explicit redistribution permission. For previews, notarized attestation acceptable but cryptographic signature required before GA/paid hosting.
tanvi_marketplace: UX plan: show a "redistribution-verified" badge when addendum + license + checksum are present. For hosted bundles we will display "hosted-by: novus" vs "hosted-by: redwood" and add a small hovercard linking to the addendum PDF.
emmie_partnerships: Action items and owners: omar -> draft 1-paragraph addendum and export-control checkbox; leo -> model_card template + preflight script `tools/verify_marketplace_bundle.sh`; tanvi -> badge spec + hosting labels; novus -> provide manifest + license by EOD Tue. Target: draft addendum + demo preflight by next Tue.
novus_partner: we can do that. about signatures: some of our contributors don't have PGP keys — will notarized attestation be OK for preview?
omar_legal: yes for preview only. we'll accept notarized attestation for preview listings. Add clause: must provide cryptographic signature (PGP or similar) before any paid or GA hosting.
leo_engineering: preflight CLI prototype: `./verify_marketplace_bundle.sh --bundle ./novus_bundle.tar.gz` -> returns exit 0 when license+checksum+model_card present and writes `marketplace-verify.json`. We'll iterate on error codes.
emmie_partnerships: Great — I'll send a partner-facing checklist email that lists 6 items: license, weights checksum, model_card.json, tokenizer, provenance statement (signed/notarized), hosting preference. Sync Wed 9:30 to finalize. :calendar:
tanvi_marketplace: noted. will add hovercopy explaining what "redistribution-verified" means (short, non-legal text).
emmie_partnerships: If anyone thinks of edge cases (third-party escrow, embargoed datasets, dual-licensed weights), drop them here and we'll loop in legal. :eyes:
